mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may potentiate propylthiouracil's agranulocytosis risk and impair thyroid function monitoring due to altered renal clearance.
action: Monitor complete blood count, renal function, and electrolytes closely during concurrent use; maintain adequate hydration during amphotericin B therapy and consider alternative antifungal if possible.
